title: The first minute
persona: Pan-India observer, late 20s, close-mic, calm. Sounds like someone who has watched the VOD, not like a shoutcaster.
mic_note: Even pace. Stress the last content word of each sentence. Do not punch 'twenty'.

cues.spoken: Most players lose the match before it starts.
cues.performance: [close, no shout] Most players lose the match before it starts.

cues.spoken: They push one knock. The zone is still twenty seconds away.
cues.performance: [drop the pace on the zone] They push one knock. The zone is still twenty seconds away.

cues.spoken: The fight can wait. The zone will not.
cues.performance: [deadpan] The fight can wait. The zone will not.
cues.mix_note: End clean so the card can be read in silence.

intentional_silence.reason: Card reads ROTATE FIRST. Do not read it aloud.
